title: columnea corymbosa
intro: Columnea corymbosa, commonly known as the Monkey Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and fever, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Columnea corymbosa include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help relieve coughs and congestion. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
